deploybot: [migration-slot] Requesting maintenance window 05/03 02:00-03:00 UTC for migration m-7007 (create shadow functional index + compact backfill). Claim in 10m or slot will be released. canaries=2.
Harper: TL;DR: build with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY, run chunked backfill; final swap is a fast rename under ACCESS EXCLUSIVE for ~200-600ms. Backfill throttle default=450 r/s; autotune on replica lag.
Vince: We need cross-region caution: some read-replicas in eu-west lag more frequently. Can we scope canaries to us-east only and delay eu rollout until post-verification?
Harper: Yes — canaries in us-east only. Global rollouts gated until 30m post-swap and eu read-reps are off-path until manual-unpin. Add feature-flag email_index_ready to prevent new path in eu.
SRE-oncall: I'll add a region-aware autothrottle: if eu replica_lag > 25s for >90s during build, pause eu workers and annotate thread. Also will set pager cooldown and suppress duplicate index_build alerts for 60m.
Mina: I'll own the cutover window and be on-call 01:45-03:15 UTC. Smoke tests: GET /profile?email=test@example.com should be <180ms and 200 OK after swap. I'll paste timestamps here.
Vince: Please pin canary nodes to release-3.5.1-dbpatch to avoid accidental feature enables. If canary fails, rollback to release-3.5.0.
Harper: SQL (sanitized):
```
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS users_email_shadow_idx ON users ((lower(email_norm))) WITH (fillfactor=90);
-- chunked backfill workers fill shadow index
-- swap: BEGIN; LOCK TABLE users IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE; ALTER INDEX users_email_shadow_idx RENAME TO users_email_idx; COMMIT;
```
SRE-oncall: Rollback options: 1) Abort pre-swap: stop workers, leave old index active (no service impact). 2) Post-swap quick revert: under short lock rename new->tmp, old->active (expected lock <1s). 3) If old index dropped, full rebuild required (costly). Runbook will include explicit commands.
ops-bot: Holdpoint created: manual-unpin required to proceed past canary. Auto-abort if preflight fails. Release notes will include migration id m-7007 and tag release-3.5.1-dbpatch.
Vince: Also add a temporary tourniquet rate-limit on profile endpoints during rollout (50% of normal) to limit blast radius if planner chooses new index unexpectedly.
SRE-oncall: I'll add the tourniquet rule for 30m around swap and prepare quick rollback play.
Mina: Claiming slot now. deploybot: start canaries in us-east at 02:00 UTC and post canary health + go/no-go here.
deploybot: Slot claimed. Will post status updates and final decision in this thread.
